checks: item1053 authored fraction to current item

associations.title: Acquérir une cible d’attaque selon portée et rayons corporels
associations.finding: Command validates enemy, protection and visibility; pursuit and attack guards compare center distance with attacker AttackRange + target body radius. Target radius uses gameplay profile or local65/40 fallback; source radius is not added by this expression.
associations.remaining: Qualify original range convention, both-body bounds, fallback radius and each actor/form; native selection/pathfinding radius must not substitute gameplay radius.

associations.title: Déclencher les dégâts au temps d’impact historique
associations.finding: Basic and critical profiles feed tick-quantized windup; melee hits at release and ranged hits after homing flight. Timing formula/defaults are current reconstruction; all122 basic and122 critical input rows are checked separately.
associations.remaining: Qualify original timing formula, animation events, rounding, speed scaling, per-form attacks and impact clock; data membership alone proves no historical timing parity.

associations.title: Annuler le wind-up avant émission sans produire de dégâts
associations.finding: cancel_windup refuses noncancelable windup; otherwise cancels presentation and removes windup. Already-emitted projectiles are stored separately and are not removed by this function.
associations.remaining: Qualify native cancellation boundaries, control/displacement branches and event timing; no all-champion cancel behavior acceptance.

associations.title: Respecter la cadence après annulation et changement de cible
associations.finding: A new windup sets next_attack=tick+cadence; cancel_windup resets it to current tick. Repeated same-target orders return after validity guards; different-target active windup calls cancellation. Cached critical roll is separate.
associations.remaining: Determine original cooldown policy after cancel/retarget, repeated commands and animation resets; local immediate re-eligibility is not historical cadence evidence.

associations.title: Appliquer les resets d’attaque autorisés par une capacité
associations.finding: Accepted Trundle Q removes windup, clears cached critical roll and resets next_attack to current tick before arming. Garen Q cast branch sets speed/empower durations; it does not reset next_attack in that branch.
associations.remaining: Identify all reset-capable abilities and original policy; Trundle Q reset is explicitly reconstructed and must not stand for all champions or prove Garen reset parity.

native_bindings.selector: SpellData.DynamicTooltip,Effect1/2/3Level1Amount; authored Q input only, not reset policy

associations.title: Calculer les critiques et leurs multiplicateurs
associations.finding: Critical chance/multiplier come from native profiles plus local growth/items. SplitMix64 samples a local roll; basic attacks exclude local empowered/TrundleQ and structures from that path. No recovered Riot streak correction.
associations.remaining: Qualify original RNG/streak policy, critical exceptions, structure handling, champions/items and float rounding; retain authored vs default values.

associations.title: Déclencher les effets à l’impact une seule fois par impact admissible
associations.finding: Released attack flow removes a projectile when it resolves; melee resolves one windup branch. Trundle Q calls basic_attack_hit once and then consumes its arm before committing effects. These are specific local paths, not an exhaustive on-hit dispatcher.
associations.remaining: Identify every on-hit effect, eligibility and callback ordering; prove deduplication under retries/reentrancy and original proc interactions across champions/items.

associations.title: Appliquer le vol de vie aux catégories de dégâts autorisées
associations.finding: basic_attack_hit heals a living player source for nonstructure targets from post_mitigation * life_steal. Local basis is before shield/overkill limiting; direct apply_damage spell paths do not automatically call it. Item1053 authored fraction is checked.
associations.remaining: Qualify historical damage categories, shields, overkill, reflected damage and champion/item exceptions; the current basis is a local contract, not native server proof.

associations.title: Maintenir ou supprimer un projectile lorsque sa cible meurt ou devient invisible
associations.finding: Flight checks target existence/health; it tracks current target position without a visibility test in the postlaunch loop. Prelaunch checks visibility. Shooter death does not remove flight, while absent source can make basic_attack_hit fail. Server life-cycle and visible snapshots are distinct.
associations.remaining: Qualify native postlaunch visibility/death/removal policy and render/network projection; inspect all missile categories, not just this basic projectile vector.

native_bindings.selector: SpellData.MissileSpeed; does not specify visibility/death policy

associations.title: Synchroniser les projectiles de tours et sbires avec l’impact serveur
associations.finding: World schedules resolves=tick+windup+travel with travel computed from initial distance/speed. Prelaunch dead/stunned sources cancel; launched hits can persist for retained source objects. This pending-hit scheduler differs from champion homing flight; no full visual synchronization qualified.
associations.remaining: Qualify original tower/minion windup, missile data, target death/FoW/trajectory, latency and visual impact correspondence for both teams/all NPC kinds.
